About.title: Developer, builder, entrepreneur.
About.subtitle: Building products, end to end.
paragraphs: I'm Maël, a French fullstack developer and co-founder of Wenoble.
I design and build web products, from the first idea to production.
My focus sits at the intersection of product, engineering and AI.

Stack.title: Tools I like to build with.

tools.name: React
tools.description: My go-to UI library. Component-driven interfaces, from dashboards to marketing sites.

tools.name: Next.js
tools.description: The framework behind most of my products: routing, server rendering and APIs in one place.

tools.name: TypeScript
tools.description: Types everywhere, front to back. Fewer bugs, safer refactors, faster onboarding.

tools.name: Tailwind CSS
tools.description: Utility-first styling to design directly in the code and keep UIs consistent.

tools.name: Webflow
tools.description: Visual development for marketing sites that teams can edit themselves, without a developer.

tools.name: Node.js
tools.description: JavaScript on the server for APIs, workers, scripts and integrations.

tools.name: Express
tools.description: Minimal Node.js server for lightweight APIs, webhooks and quick prototypes.

tools.name: NestJS
tools.description: Structured backends for larger APIs: modules, dependency injection, clean architecture.

tools.name: PostgreSQL
tools.description: The database I trust: relational, reliable, and powerful with JSONB and extensions.

tools.name: MongoDB
tools.description: Document database when the data is flexible, nested or changes shape often.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.description: Postgres with auth, storage and realtime built in. Perfect to ship an MVP fast.

tools.name: Claude
tools.description: My main LLM for agents, RAG pipelines and AI features shipped to production.

tools.name: OpenAI
tools.description: GPT models and embeddings for generation, classification and semantic search.

tools.name: MCP
tools.description: Model Context Protocol: connecting LLMs to real tools, APIs and data sources.

tools.name: Vercel
tools.description: Zero-config deployments, preview URLs on every branch, edge network by default.

tools.name: Cloudflare
tools.description: DNS, CDN, security and edge workers in front of everything I put online.

tools.name: Docker
tools.description: Reproducible environments, from local development to production containers.

tools.name: GitHub
tools.description: Repositories, pull requests, Actions for CI/CD and issues to run the project.
